idea-plugin.name: Page Builder Support
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ IDEA plugin for Page Builder Pattern support. Provides IDE support for @GenerateMethods annotation by showing generated methods in autocomplete and removing red squiggles.
Features: - Shows generated click, sendKeys, isDisplayed, getText, selectByText, selectByIndex methods - Supports method chaining with proper return types - Compatible with @GenerateMethods annotation processing
